# Neptune

**Parity grade: A** · SDK `aws-sdk-go-v2/service/neptune@v1.53.3` · last audited 2026-10-12 (`0c1472972`)

## Coverage

| Metric | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Feature families | 13 (13 ok) |

| Resource leaks | clean |

### Known gaps

- UNVERIFIABLE: OrderableDBInstanceOption.SupportedNetworkTypes stays empty; the pinned SDK states no per-instance-class network type support.
- SPARQL is not served in any engine mode. The port speaks plain HTTP/WebSocket and unencrypted Bolt, not TLS. With NEPTUNE_GREMLIN=container (docker mode only) Gremlin runs in a stock tinkerpop/gremlin-server container whose graph is separate from the in-process openCypher/Bolt graph (the default in-process mode shares one graph).
- Bolt: explicit transactions hold the cluster graph exclusively until COMMIT/ROLLBACK/disconnect, and results are materialised before PULL streaming. Not smoke-tested against a real neo4j driver (none available on the dev box); proven by the pkgs/bolt protocol tests and the neptune bolt_front_test.go.
- openCypher subset (services/neptune/opencypher): CALL/UNION/FOREACH/LOAD CSV, pattern predicates in WHERE, list comprehensions, shortestPath, temporal/spatial types and constraints are not implemented and return UnsupportedOperationException or MalformedQueryException.
- NEPTUNE_GREMLIN=container: the Gremlin graph in the container is not captured by cluster snapshots or persistence; relaunched clusters start with an empty Gremlin graph. In the default in-process mode the single shared graph is persisted. The writer and reader endpoints are the same host:port.
- Gremlin subset (services/neptune/gremlin): lambdas, sessions and multi-request transactions, mergeV/mergeE, tree/subgraph/sack/math/sample/index and string-manipulation steps, meta-properties, g.tx(), profile/explain and variable assignment in scripts are not implemented and return MalformedQueryException/UnsupportedOperationException. Integer and float widths are folded to Int64/Double on write; property cardinality is single (list/set stored as a list value); vertex property ids are derived, not stored.

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- DescribeDBClusterSnapshots IncludePublic/IncludeShared add other accounts' snapshots; single-account emulator, so there are none to add (SnapshotType=public/shared are evaluated).
- DeleteDBInstance SkipFinalSnapshot=false creates no snapshot: Neptune has no DB-instance snapshot resource in the pinned SDK.

### Deferred

- RESOLVED 2026-09-11 (gopherstack-jd33): "8-parameter representative approximation" catalog gap -- see the top-level 2026-09-11 note and the DBParameterGroup/DBClusterParameterGroup family notes above. Residual, still-disclosed gap: neptune_lookup_cache's documented default flip to "1" when an R5d instance joins the cluster is not modeled (this backend's parameter override store isn't keyed by instance class); neptune_slow_query_log_threshold has no documented AllowedValues range to enforce (only a default is documented).
- RESOLVED 2026-09-11 (gopherstack-jd33): GlobalCluster Failover/Switchover silent-no-op-on-unresolvable-target gap -- see the top-level 2026-09-11 note and the GlobalCluster family note above.
